main_text.p: An. Christi37.Paulus Damasco in Arabiam proficiscitur.Gal. 1.pòst redit Damascum. Act. 9. 2. Corint. 11. Gal. 1. ac triennio post conuersionem venit Hierosolymam ad Petrum. Gal. 1.
39.Paulus fugiens Iudæos,venit Cæsaream Phœ-5niciæ,inde Tarsum Ciliciæ. Act. 9.
41.42Ecclesia Antiochena plantatur, ibique disci-43.puli primùm vocantur Christiani. Act. 11.

44.45Herodes Agrippa ecclesias persequitur, in-1046.& seqq.carcerat Petrum, & Iacobum gladio occidit. Act. 12. Paulus & Barnabas peragrat varias provincias, ibique ecclesias fundant. Postea redeunt Antiochiam. Act. 13. 14. Quæ omnia collocanda sunt in an. 45. 46. &seqq. vsque ad an. 50.15

50.Apostoli concilium habent Hierosolymis. Act. 15. Obseruant docti, quatuor conciliorum mentionem fieri in Actis: primi, in quo eligitur Matthias, cap. 1. secundi, in quo diaconi instituuntur, cap. 6. tertii, in quo Iudaica instituta antiquantur,20 c. 15. quartum eliciunt ex historiâc. 21. de Pauli aduentu Hierosolymam.
51.Paulus cum rescripto apostolico redit Antiochiam. Act. 15. Hic est annus 14 ab eâ profectione, quæ facta est post ipsius conuersionem an. Chri-25sti 37. Gal. 1.

Deinceps in Actis describitur peregrinatio Pauli. Hic itaque apostoli Pauli itinerarium paucis trademus. Et primò quidé Paulus Antiochiæ docet: postea secessione Barnabæ factâ & allecto Si-30lâ Syriam & Siciliam peragrat. c. 15. venit Derben & Lystram: Timotheum sibi adsciscit & circumcidit. c. 16. Peragrant Phrygiam, Galatiam, Mysiam. Veniunt Troadem. Inde Samothracem,ac post Neapolim,& Philippos,vbi Lydia conuersa.3552. ibid. Paulus & Silas per Amphipolim & Apollo-

page.notes: Printed "pòst" and "primùm" carry accents as printed. "historiâc.21." is printed with the accent on â run into "c.21."; reading uncertain. "Chri-sti" is split across lines as printed. The long s and the ligature in "adsciscit" (printed with an f-like form) are read as s. The line numbers at the far left edge of the scan (5, 10, 15 ...) belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The printed "Gal.1." and "Act.9." carry no space as printed.
